description: SET ADDRESS OF (data-pointer assignment), ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 7 + §2023:8.4.3.11 ADDRESS OF - a COBOL-2002 introduction. LIVE (Phase-4b increment 2, DEVLOG 617): both directions - SET p TO ADDRESS OF x (the sender form; x's record is forced onto a StorageCell so a CellPointer window can alias it) and SET ADDRESS OF b TO p (SR18 - the receiver shall be BASED; GR12-13 snapshot assignment). Binder-side registry gate (a grammar predicate would fall through to the other SET alternatives and mis-diagnose). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 SET statement has three functions - '(1) The SET statement establishes reference points for table handling operations by setting indices associated with table elements', '(2) The SET statement is also used to alter the status of external switches', '(3) The SET statement is also used to alter the value of conditional variables' (§1985:VI.6.23.1) - and ADDRESS is no 1985 reserved word (§1985:IV.8 runs ADD, ADVANCING: its rows '| ADD | CONTENT | END-EVALUATE | IF |' and '| ADVANCING | CONTINUE | END-IF | IN |'); §2002:14.8.35 adds 'assigning the address of a based item' with its Format 7 (data-pointer-assignment) (§2002:14.8.35.2 SR18: 'Data-name-1 shall be a based data item'; §2002:14.8.35.3 GR12: 'If data-name-1 is specified, the address identified by identifier-6 is assigned to each based item referenced by data-name-1'), §2002:8.4.2.11 the sender ('A data-address-identifier references the unique data item that contains the address of a data item'), §2002:F.1 item 6 adds ADDRESS to the reserved words, and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 103: 'A new class of data is introduced, a pointer type which holds data and program addresses in a machine-specific or system-specific way.' §2014:14.9.35 and §2014:14.9.35.2 SR18 carry it, so 2014 = 2023.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SAMX1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 X PIC X(5) VALUE "HELLO".
01 P USAGE POINTER.
01 B PIC X(5) BASED.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET P TO ADDRESS OF X.
    SET ADDRESS OF B TO P.
    STOP RUN.
